seo.title: Kudla House Restaurant Karama | Mangalorean Ghee Roast, Seafood Thali & Neer Dosa
seo.description: Kudla House Restaurant, Street 9A, Sheikh Hamdan Colony, Karama: authentic Mangalorean and coastal Karnataka food with prawns, squid and kori ghee roast, seafood thali, fish tawa, king fish masala fry and neer dosa. Open 12 PM to midnight. 4.7 from 326 reviews.

hero.lede: Coastal Karnataka cooking in Karama: prawns, squid and kori ghee roast, seafood thali with two kinds of fish fry, king fish masala fry, neer dosa and kori rotti.
hero.image_alt: Mangalorean seafood thali on banana leaf
